meta.title: Morya Map — Ganeshotsav queues, honestly
meta.description: Where the darshan queue starts, how long it really takes, and how to reach Mumbai's famous Ganpati mandals. 14–25 September 2026.

wait.estimateLabel: Estimate — based on past festivals, not live
wait.reportedLabel: Reported {mins} min ago by a visitor
wait.reportedJustNow: Reported just now by a visitor
wait.disclaimer: Waits vary hugely. If you are travelling with elders or children, plan for the upper end.

mandal.walk: about {mins} min walk to the mandal
mandal.bestTimeLine: Quietest between 4–7 am. Evenings after 7 pm are the heaviest — expect the top of the range.
mandal.holdingPointsHint: As the crowd grows, police extend the queue backwards through these points. No. 1 is closest to the mandap.
mandal.noPin: The exact queue-start pin isn't set yet — ask a volunteer on the ground.

home.title: Where's the line?
home.subtitle: Queue starts, honest waits and how to reach {count} famous Ganpati mandals across Mumbai.
home.mapNote: Pins mark where the darshan queue starts — not where the idol is.
home.noPinsYet: Map pins are still being verified on the ground and will appear as they're confirmed. Use the list below meanwhile.
home.sortNote: Sorted by area and popularity — never by "shortest queue right now".

report.title: Where does the line start right now?
report.instructions: Tap the landmark where people are joining the queue right now. One tap — no account needed.
report.thanks: Thank you! Your report will appear once a moderator confirms it.
report.moderation: Reports are checked by a moderator before they go live.
report.completedHint: Tell us when you joined the line and when you got darshan — it makes next year's estimates better. Times are in IST.
report.rateLimited: You've sent a few reports recently. Please try again in a while.
report.invalid: That didn't go through — please pick a landmark and try again.
report.noLandmarks: This queue's landmark list isn't set up yet. Reporting opens soon.

footer.honesty: We never show fake live data. Every figure is labelled with where it came from.
